1 These unaudited consolidated financial results of the Holding company have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles prescribed in Indian Accounting Standards Ind AS as prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act 2013 as amended read with relevant rules thereunder and in terms of Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015 the Regulations
2 The Sales Purchase have been recognised based on contract price with the customers vendors which are subject to escalations and de escalations basis annual price revision The Group estimated such escalations and de escalations on best estimate basis and these will be formalised by year end
3 In line with the provisions of Ind AS 108 Operating Segment the Group is engaged in the business of manufacturing of different seating systems and components for automobiles including two wheeler which constitute single reporting business segment and the group operates only in one geographical segment India Accordingly there are no separate reportable segments
4 In the financial year 2023 24 the Income Tax Department the Department conducted a search under section 132 of the Income Tax Act 1961 at certain premises of the Company including its manufacturing locations and residences of certain employees key managerial personnel Pursuant to the search and subsequent assessment proceedings the Company received assessment demand orders aggregating to Rs 510 point 39 lakhs including penalty for assessment years 2020 21 2021 22 2023 24 2024 25 In addition a demand of Rs 134 point 01 lakhs including penalty was raised for assessment year 2022 23 The penalty demand orders for assessment years 2023 24 and 2024 25 were dropped by the income tax department The Company filed appeals against the aforesaid assessment orders and also filed rectification applications in respect of outstanding demands aggregating to Rs. 389 point 98 lakhs pertaining to assessment years 2020 21 and 2021 22 Subsequently pursuant to the appeals filed by the Company the Commissioner of Income Tax Appeals deleted the entire additions made for assessment year 2023 24 and 2024 25 and granted partial relief to the company for assessment year 2021 22 thereby reducing the demand from Rs 510 point 39 lakhs to Rs 414 point 42 lakhs
During the current quarter the Income Tax department has filed an appeal before the ITAT against the relief granted by the CIT A as mentioned above in respect of assessment year 2023 24 The Company has also filed appeal before the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal ITAT against the demand sustained by the CIT A for the assessment year 2021 22 Appeal for assessment year 2022 23 remains pending before the CIT A
Based on the Holding companys assessment and legal advice obtained management believes that it has a favourable position in respect of the ongoing proceedings including the appeals filed by the Holding company and the Department Pending outcome of appeal proceedings no adjustment has been made to these financial results
5 In the financial year 2025 26 the Group recognised exceptional items amounting to Rs. 64 point 75 lakhs representing an expense towards employee benefit obligations arising from the implementation of the Code on Wages 2019
6 During the quarter ended September 2026 the Holding company granted 66641 stock options at an exercise price of Rs 500 point 50 per option under the Employee Stock Option Plan 2024 subject to satisfying specified vesting criteria based on market condition and performance conditions The same has been accounted for in accordance with Ind AS 102 Share Based Payment
7 The Group had discontinued recognizing its share of losses of Rs 12 point 37 lakhs from its investment in Toyota Boshoku Relan India Private Limited joint venture after the accumulated losses exceeded the carrying amount of the investment of Rs 0 point 50 lakhs If the joint venture subsequently reports profits the Group will resume recognizing its share of profits only after the profits equal the previously unrecognized losses
8 The Consolidated financial results include the results of the company 2 subsidiary companies 1 associate company and 3 joint venture companies
9 These unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30 2026 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and are approved by Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on November 04 2026 These unaudited consolidated financial results have been reviewed by the statutory auditors of the Company in accordance with Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015 the Regulations as amended The statutory auditors have issued an unmodified conclusion on these unaudited consolidated financial results
